question: Why does poison not enter the body even when bitten by great serpents?
premises: Poison does not enter the body.
This holds even when bitten by great serpents.
inference: The verse claims immunity to serpent poison in the body.
uncertainties: daṃśito may modify the subject or an implied person.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one is bitten by great serpents.
